'''Vermin control droids''' were used at the [[Imperial mining complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]]. Armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Poison gas/Legends|poison gas]], they were employed by [[Control (droid)|Control]] in an attempt to kill a [[Green squad|team]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s.<ref name="Freedom" />
